compliance.summary: The page is built to sell AI development and forward-deployed architect services, not GoGloby’s approved recruiting and staffing services. It also makes unsupported claims about guarantees, security, performance metrics, pricing, and credentials; decide whether to remove the page before carrying any of those claims into other content.
